runs.entry: Price **$27.39** (2026-10-15 close, through `tools/run.py`, aggregator, flagged). Shares **69,935,827**, one class (10-Q cover, 0001193125-26-332959, `Screens/cover_shares.py`; checked against the same 10-Q's balance sheet, 68,875,856 issued and outstanding at 2026-06-30, no treasury shares, the difference about the TCO consideration shares of the 8-K of 2026-06-15; the 8-K of 2026-08-10 issued no shares); cap **$1,915.5M**; debt and finance leases $25.1M against cash $222.1M at 2026-06-30, before the $65M TCO cash paid 2026-07-01. Sovereign **5.43%** (US Treasury par curve, 30-year, 2026-10-15). Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (0001193125-26-067228), 10-K FY2024 (0000950170-25-031003), the 10-Q to 2026-06-30, the proxy (0001193125-26-129169, read only for facts after the stop), the 2026 8-Ks, the merger prospectus 424B3 (0001193125-24-194905) for Legacy Innovex's 2021 to 2023 statements, Dril-Quip's 8-K of 2024-07-08 (item 4.02) and Dril-Quip's own 10-K figures 2012 to 2023; one figure cross-checked (FY2025 revenue $978,251K, face of the statement against XBRL). `tools/run.py`'s owner-earnings window rejected by the analyst because it mixes the two registrants; owner cash built from the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. Q1 IN (activity-driven consumables read off the figures; the commodity dependence not a Q1 stop under the framework's commodity paragraph). **Q2 OUT**: a standing castle that protects only ordinary returns; the field's durable players over 2016 to 2025, operating income over revenue, Weatherford -11.1% (2019 untagged), NOV -11.8%, Halliburton 4.4%; the filer's own Item 1A: "Some jobs are awarded on a bid basis", "Pricing is one of the primary factors", "numerous small companies capable of competing effectively", largest customers seeking "pricing concessions"; the Dril-Quip half (Subsea Solutions 24% and Surface Wellheads 8% of 2025 revenue) a castle shown crossed, operating margin about 30% in 2014 and 2015, then losses or about 1% in seven of the eight years 2016 to 2023; Legacy Innovex 4.8%, 16.4%, 17.5% 2021 to 2023 with no filed trough but 2021; the combined company 7.4% (2024) and 13.6% (2025, 9.5% without $39.8M of asset-sale gains). One segment, so no parts table; TOO HARD (NATURE) considered by the analyst for the untested Legacy half and rejected, the filer's own risk statements and the Dril-Quip record answering the question on the evidence. Q3 to Q12 not reached. **Integrity facts recorded, not judged:** a jury found the DWS subsidiary's patent infringement "willful" and awarded $47.6M (accrued $51.6M, appeal); Dril-Quip's 2021 statements declared not to be relied upon in July 2024 (about $67M of inventory write-downs classed as restructuring); the featured Adjusted EBITDA adds back stock pay and the 2025 bonus was paid on an Adjusted EBITDA goal of $195M; a $75.0M dividend to Legacy holders on the merger closing day; Amberjack, 33.2% in the proxy, "not limited in its ability to compete with us"; the former Saudi agent's receivables recovery unexplained. After the stop: acquisitions $300.9M net cash 2021 to 2025 against $97.8M of owner cash before purchases; receivables plus inventory about 50% of 2025 revenue; buybacks at $14.89 (2025 H1) and $24.59 (February 2026) with no stated price; Dril-Quip's retained earnings $1,501M (2016) to $951M (2023); net deferred tax asset $102.4M on a $457.3M NOL. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash on the combined Legacy plus Dril-Quip averages (Q7 (c), the merger paid in shares) 2021 to 2025 all-equity 14.3, -81.9, 33.6, 31.0, 101.0, average $19.6M; a serial acquirer, so the organic pair is central, and the filer reports no organic growth and the series changes sign, so the range is the no-growth case alone; TCO added at its filed $11M of free cash flow; value **about $10.43 a share** all-equity against $27.39 (the literal window $8.46 beside; 2025 plus TCO alone $31.86 beside, not deciding); fair price **about $6.75 all-equity** ($4.55 equity-only beside; 2025 plus TCO $18.39 beside); central yield 1.8%, the 2025 case 6.4%, no case earning the floor; not armed, the box being OUT at Q2. Three CONVENTIONS of the run: a 67-day Dril-Quip gap in 2024 prorated, the tax shelter spread over four years, the $51.6M Impulse accrual deducted like debt. Contamination declared by the analyst: a `Test Runs/` listing showing the HMH, NESR, NGS, NOV, OIS, SEI and USAC run names of 2026-10-16, none opened, NOV used only through its own filings; the NESR fold commit subjects and a memory index line; none used. Commits c0fb0184, 2afeb956, b06f82a3, 58385c6e, four. Position note filled at the fold: not held (`PORTFOLIO.md` carries no line for INVX, Innovex or Dril-Quip). Citations: the analyst's `check_cites.py` PASS (39 ids, 31 quoted fragments); the dispatcher's `dispatcher_cite_check.py` no phantom, no E-id and no slip among 9 tight pairs; the wider sweep's misses are filing quotations. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) a reverse merger: the framework does not say which history to read when the accounting acquirer is the private company, nor how to fill a period no filing covers; (2) Q7 (c)'s organic pair when the filer reports no organic growth collapses to no growth, not said in terms; (3) a business half a proven-ordinary castle and half an untested one, with one reported segment: section C's OUT rule and its change-for-the-better rule both reach it and the text does not say which governs; (4) an accrued litigation payment and net debt, "On what the floor is earned" silent. Could not get: Legacy Innovex figures before 2021, a Dril-Quip filing for 2024-07-01 to 2024-09-05, a unit-cost comparison with rivals, an organic growth figure, the history of the former Saudi agent's receivables.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a standing castle that protects only ordinary returns; Weatherford, NOV and Halliburton -11.1%, -11.8% and 4.4% on revenue over 2016 to 2025; the filer's own words put price first in bids won against effective small local rivals and customers seeking concessions; the Dril-Quip half a castle shown crossed, about 30% margins in 2014 and 2015, losses or about 1% in seven of eight years 2016 to 2023; TOO HARD (NATURE) for the untested Legacy half considered and rejected. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: the willful-infringement verdict against DWS ($47.6M), Dril-Quip's 2024 non-reliance on its 2021 statements, the featured Adjusted EBITDA adding back stock pay with the bonus paid on it, a $75.0M dividend to Legacy holders on the merger closing day. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: the no-growth case alone on the organic pair, value about $10.43 a share all-equity against $27.39, fair about $6.75 all-equity ($4.55 equity-only), not armed. Framework gaps for the operator: which history in a reverse merger; Q7 (c) with no organic figure; half a proven-ordinary castle and half an untested one; litigation accruals and net debt.
